market_summary: At 13:30 UTC during the London/NY Overlap, market-wide news expansion produced sharp upside spikes across EURUSD, GBPUSD, US100, and BTCUSD, each followed by immediate rejection wicks back inside session Value Areas. With CVD metrics displaying neutral commitment or bearish divergence, and prices consolidating mid-channel near VWAP/POC magnets, all four pairs lack high-probability continuation edge, warranting a disciplined HOLD.

signals.rationale: 1) Volume Profile: Signal candle closed inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10527 to VAH 1.10635) and slightly above POC (1.10598), with live price (1.10555) slipping back below POC into mid-value. 2) CVD: Cumulative delta is +1,788 (NEUTRAL) with a slope of +771.12, reflecting a lack of strong directional institutional aggression. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP provides active liquidity. 4) Trend / Baselines: Price tested above VWAP (1.10580) and EMA50 (1.10570), but live price has slipped back below both flat baselines, signaling range chop. 5) ATR-Band Position: Signal bar spiked through the upper ATR band (1.10667) before retreating toward mid-channel near EMA20 (1.10547). 6) RVOL: Last bar printed RVOL 3.019 (bright yellow spike), confirming high-volume selling into the upper wick. 7) S/R & Extremes: Clear liquidity sweep of S/R 1.10662 with rejection back toward support at 1.10543; GEX is null. The failed breakout and retracement inside Value Area mandate a disciplined hold.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral, price mean-reverting around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: 1) Volume Profile: Signal bar closed above VAH (1.32374) and above POC (1.32345), but live price (1.32368) has fallen back into the Value Area to retest VAH. 2) CVD: CVD is +1,808 (NEUTRAL) with positive slope (+3,217.96) reflecting high two-way news turnover. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. 4) Trend / Baselines: Price is holding just above VWAP (1.32323) and EMA50 (1.32323), but momentum is stalling along horizontal baselines. 5) ATR-Band Position: Signal candle pierced upper ATR band (1.32456) and closed back beneath it, with live price drifting to upper-mid channel. 6) RVOL: RVOL is 3.703 (bright yellow spike), indicating heavy volume exhaustion at the highs. 7) S/R & Extremes: Strong sweep of Session High (1.32503) followed by failure to hold above S/R 1.32431 and S/R 1.32391; GEX is null. Rejection of session highs back toward fair value signals poor long reward-to-risk.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral, retesting VWAP/EMA50 after rejection at highs

signals.rationale: 1) Volume Profile: Signal bar closed inside Value Area (VAL 28209.76 to VAH 28412.58) and above POC (28264.08); live price (28349.84) is retracing deeper into the Value Area toward VWAP. 2) CVD: CVD is +1.57 (NEUTRAL) with a slope of +1.65, showing negligible order-flow momentum. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. 4) Trend / Baselines: Price remains structurally above VWAP (28312.59) and EMA50 (28293.16). 5) ATR-Band Position: Signal candle spiked through upper ATR band (28413.52) reaching 28491.0 before a sharp retracement back to mid-channel. 6) RVOL: RVOL is 1.22 (US100 CFD tick volume rarely prints >2.0 yellow spikes; absence of yellow bars alone does not veto, but volume remains unsupportive of breakout expansion). 7) S/R & Extremes: Sharp rejection wick below Session High (28513.99) and rejection back under VAH (28412.58); GEX is null outside NY cash hours. Mid-channel placement after a high-wick rejection warrants staying sidelined.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish, holding above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of VAH at 28412.58 and upper ATR band

signals.rationale: 1) Volume Profile: Signal candle closed inside the Value Area (VAL 68171.24 to VAH 69802.27) and above POC (69219.76); live price (69580.3) is consolidating mid-range. 2) CVD: CVD is -0.05 (BEARISH) with flat slope (-0.0), diverging sharply from the bullish price expansion. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. 4) Trend / Baselines: Price reclaimed VWAP (69353.62) and EMA50 (69463.13), attempting a structural baseline recovery. 5) ATR-Band Position: Price spiked beyond upper ATR band (69818.70) to 70156.4 before leaving a prominent upper wick and returning below the band. 6) RVOL: RVOL reached 2.225 (bright yellow spike), confirming heavy volume on the spike. 7) S/R & Extremes: Rejection at the 70,000 level and below resistance at Prev Low 71031.0; GEX is null. Strong upper rejection combined with bearish CVD divergence warns of buyer absorption inside Value Area, favoring a HOLD.
signals.level_event: rejection of 70k psychological level and upper ATR band
